event.name: c. 2990–2980 BC: One estimate places the death of Egyptian ruler Djer in this period; dates are debated

r2SourceEvidence.review_note: The century overview places Djer's death around 2990–2980 BCE, but Djer's article dates his reign broadly around 3000 BCE and Egyptologists give widely different absolute reign dates; this is one proposed date range, not a proven death year. Djer was buried at Umm el-Qa'ab, but the location of his death is not established here. The regional point is his burial site, not a claimed death location; the radius is a gameplay setting. The -2990 slot is an approximate indexing anchor, not the only possible date or duration of a death event.
r2SourceEvidence.date_precision: One proposed range c. 2990–2980 BCE, with other chronologies substantially earlier or later; -2990 is a reference slot only.
r2SourceEvidence.location_precision: Regional reference at the Umm el-Qa'ab cemetery in Abydos, where Djer was buried; death location unknown.
